Which approach will allow them to retain and access this history over an extended period?

options.A: Enable configuration items and configure periodic evaluations.
options.B: Use configuration snapshots and store them in Amazon S3.
options.C: Enable AWS Config Rules and use CloudTrail to track changes.
options.D: Use a configuration stream and set up an Amazon RDS database for storage.

options_list: Enable configuration items and configure periodic evaluations.
Use configuration snapshots and store them in Amazon S3.
Enable AWS Config Rules and use CloudTrail to track changes.
Use a configuration stream and set up an Amazon RDS database for storage.
correct_answers_text: Use configuration snapshots and store them in Amazon S3.
